name: hbfd_rly_624_sn_fc-fc1-COMMIT
purpose: HBM die F1 forwarded-clock relay hbfd_rly_624_SN_fc: register on clk_in, clk_out = kept BUFx12f, o through the same cell on the downstream face beside clk_out; i/clk_in upstream (S), o/clk_out downstream (N), rs W; 114.48 x 21.6 um, M5 cap

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hbfd_rly_624_SN_fc u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hbm_accel/die_glue/ot_hbm_rly.sv rtl/hbm_accel/die_glue/ot_hbm_rly_fc.sv rtl/hbm_accel/die_glue/hbfd_rly_fc_masters.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: fc_words
bench.pass_regex: RLY_FC_BENCH PASS 0 errors 0 clock_errors 0 chain_errors in 20000 words
bench.min_count_regex: RLY_FC_BENCH PASS 0 errors 0 clock_errors 0 chain_errors in (\d+) words

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hbfd_rly_624_sn_fc/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hbfd_rly_624_sn_fc/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hbfd_rly_624_sn_fc --out {RUN}/record/views/hbfd_rly_624_SN_fc  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: F1 forwarded-clock variant of hbfd_rly_624_SN (owner neighbour-relative clocking; DIE-CLOCK form F1): same ot_hbm_rly stage on clk_in, clk_out + every o through one kept BUFx12f each, data face 114.48 um (<= 6 pins/um; was 64.8), outline 114.48 x 21.6
